focus: Account isolation between the two seeded accounts: open, list, link to, embed, and save each note of one account while signed in as the other account and while signed out, through the pages and through the server functions under /_serverFn.
The notes list and the read-only note page: New note, links between notes, embedded notes, backlinks, links to missing notes, and the list of notes that link to missing notes.

The sign-in page and the auth API under /api/auth: email validation, disposable email addresses, wrong and expired codes, repeated requests, sign-out, and the redirect of every page to /sign-in without a session.
knownGaps: Email sign-in codes reach only the server log, because the environment has no mail delivery. Each seeded account carries a signed session cookie for the app host instead.
A browser without a WebAuthn authenticator waits without an answer after Add a passkey and Sign in with a passkey.
Requests reach the app with no client IP header, so the rate limiter counts every client of the environment in one bucket per auth path.
The note page is read-only and the app has no editor. A note changes only through the save server function.
